name: <style=prompt><align=center>REPORT CU00</align></style>
desc: [...] In ordinary development, the subject’s sense of self consolidates and the pathway weakens accordingly. As the child individuates, access to the shared field diminishes and dream content returns to private, unstable form. In cases of prolonged neglect, attachment disruption, or developmental dissociation, this process appears incomplete. The subject does not fully individuate. Instead, they remain psychically turned inward, sustaining the pathway well beyond the expected period of childhood elasticity. When this occurs, dream activity becomes unusually consistent. Subjects report not separate dreams, but a continuous place. Distances remain stable. Structures recur. Environmental logic becomes fixed. In advanced presentations, the boundary between the individual dream-state and the shared field may begin to fail. This failure is the basis of the present work. If the subject’s pathway can be maintained and strengthened under controlled conditions, the dream no longer functions as an isolated internal construct. Environmental details, foreign memories, and externally sourced impressions may enter the dream architecture and persist there with increasing fidelity. In other words, the subject gains access to a collective unconsciousness. Every mind’s point of significance. Current findings suggest that this means tapping into an infinite well of information and data. [..]
